intro: A fairly quiet Wednesday. The main threads are AI search keeping clicks away from publishers, creators losing credit for sales they drive, and platforms building their own shopping tools ahead of Black Friday.

must_reads.title: With Search Traffic Down 70%, People Inc. Bets On Revenue Beyond Site Visits
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: People Inc. (People, InStyle, Southern Living) says its Google search traffic is down 70% in two years, with AI Overviews on 90% of its searches. When big publishers lose clicks, affiliate links on their pages get fewer chances to earn, so they look for money that doesn't depend on site visits.

must_reads.title: Creators drive demand but miss commissions: The attribution problem in India's affiliate economy
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Creators in India are driving sales but losing commission because tracking breaks as shoppers move between apps and stores. Broken attribution is an industry-wide problem, not just ours, and it's the reason link-level tracking matters.

must_reads.title: TikTok Shop AI estimates extra orders per listing fix ahead of Black Friday
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: TikTok Shop is giving US sellers its own AI tools to fix listings, make videos and join Black Friday campaigns, all inside TikTok. Each platform wants the whole shopping journey in its own app, which makes links that work across all of them more useful, not less.

must_reads.title: 'Google's crown is definitely shaky': 57% of agencies say clients are prioritising GEO for search investment
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: A survey of agencies says 57% of clients now put generative AI search (GEO) first for search spend, moving money towards creators and trusted content. If AI answers decide what shoppers see, being cited by AI becomes as important as ranking on Google.

must_reads.title: Rakuten Research Examines AI Disclosure and Trust in Creator Reviews
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Only 38% of shoppers in Rakuten's survey are comfortable with a fully AI-written creator review. Trust in real creators is still the asset that drives affiliate clicks, which is good news for the creators and authors we serve.
